entities.summary: The legendary visit of Guru Padmasambhava (Guru Rinpoche) who is credited with introducing Vajrayana Buddhism to Bhutan, the founding of sacred sites including Taktsang (Tiger's Nest), and the establishment of Buddhism as the dominant faith.
